analysis: The PR changes documentation only: docs/provider/cli-reference.md gains one row at head line ~1687 in the environment-variable forwarding table, adding `DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES` mapped to `AdmissionRateEstimators.swift` (`DeadlineAdmissionFixes.environmentKey`). The supplied units are head-text lines 1-846, which do not include the changed line (the patch excerpt is complete). I reviewed the visible portion of the doc for security-relevant claims (logout/revocation, drain, App Attest/enroll, cache settings). No security controls, code, or trust boundaries change. The new variable is a daemon-forwarded admission/deadline tuning flag; it appears to be an availability/performance knob. It touches no threat-model asset (A-001 through A-017), attestation, encryption, or authorization path as far as the supplied evidence shows. Unverified: the semantics of `DeadlineAdmissionFixes` and whether launchd forwarding of an operator-set env var could weaken admission or deadline behavior (T-010 and T-029 availability concerns). The Swift source is not supplied, so this cannot be assessed, and a doc-only row is not evidence of a regression. Related existing threat entries (T-041 cache, T-053 grant revocation) are unaffected by this change. No finding; a later pass should check the Swift implementation if the admission change is part of this PR.
